title: hieracium cochlearioides subsp. tissierei
intro: Hieracium cochlearioides subsp. tissierei, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species in the dandelion-like flowering plants family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, making it useful for treating various conditions such as skin infections and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium cochlearioides subsp. tissierei include antioxidant, anti-allergic, and anti-cancer activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
